title: Make the ship phase observable before the next billed run

completion_criteria.text: The live GitHub lane executes for the first time and either passes, or its failure is traced to a named root cause at path and line rather than being retried.
The four dispatch kinds that carry no unit become recordable, so ship and integrate can be replayed from real responses instead of hand-authored guesses.
The harness built-wait race is fixed and proven by a test red on the parent commit, so a billed run cannot be killed mid-flight and charged for nothing.
Teardown's unbounded directory removal is bounded across all three call sites, with a test proving a path outside the repository is refused.

spine.active_goal: Make the phase the engine has never completed observable, and remove the two hazards that can waste or endanger a billed run, before paying for another one.
spine.next_step: Three strands are in flight. The live GitHub lane was triggered for the first time as run 32654935845 and its result must be read. An investigator is naming which dispatch kinds go unrecorded and whether they are the ship phase ones. An implementer is bounding teardown's directory removal. The built-wait race is not started. The billed run itself is NOT this thread's work; it is the parent's c45.
spine.last_session: 2026-08-22: opened after the trunk went green and the live token was set. The four items are the prerequisites recommended before spending on another billed run.

open_risks.text: Every billed run so far bought exactly one defect and stopped — about five dollars and seventeen minutes each, because each failure is terminal, so unobservable phases are what make a run expensive

Recording a dispatch may be necessary but not sufficient for replay — the stub routes by live schema identity and resolves only four kinds, so a cassette for an unrouted kind loads, is never consumed, and can still pass
Decisions 0666 and 0674 disagree on the dispatch-kind count, twelve against eight — do not scope a fix against either number until the code has settled which vocabulary is which

Read this suite's verdict from CI rather than any local run — the primary checkout is the only honest local reader, a fresh clone adds fourteen false failures, and a linked worktree censuses an empty set

Declare work-type chore at creation on a config-only pull request — a toml file counts as source to the enforcer, and an inert work-type value is worse than none because it disables the config-only escape

out_of_scope: The billed live run itself, which is the parent thread's c45 and begins only once these four land
Teaching the replay stub the full eight-kind vocabulary, which 0674 places out of scope as an engine-behaviour change
The predecessor thread's c3, making the test job a required check, which is blocked on a human action in the GitHub UI
